name: mock-interview-2voice
title: Two-voice mock interview
description: Full-length interviewer/candidate dialogue following the standard system-design arc.
authoring_brief: Alternate turns; never let one side monologue for more than about 200 words. The interviewer pushes back at least three times and asks for numbers. The candidate states assumptions out loud and revises when challenged. Numbers must be self-consistent — if you claim 10K TPS, later storage maths has to match it.

sections.title: Requirements
sections.brief: Functional and non-functional scope, clarified by question and answer.

sections.title: Estimation
sections.brief: Back-of-envelope traffic, storage, bandwidth. Sanity-check each figure aloud.

sections.title: High-level design
sections.brief: Components and data flow. State the obvious approach and why it fails first.

sections.title: Deep dive
sections.brief: One or two components in detail, driven by interviewer pressure.

sections.title: Trade-offs
sections.brief: What was given up and under what conditions the choice flips.

sections.title: Wrap up
sections.brief: Interviewer summarises; candidate names the one thing they'd revisit.
